scenario.title: Fan-out proof
scenario.goal:
Persona: first-time-visitor.

You are a mobile user on a mobile device (414x896 @3x). Expect a mobile/touch layout.

Explore the app and stop.

Lane focus: Sign up from a phone.

When you stop, make the FIRST line of your last message exactly one of these three, on its own line: REACHED THE GOAL. / DID NOT REACH THE GOAL. / BLOCKED. Then, from the next line, say what you did, what confused you, and where you hesitated.
